matamala2021_lysosome_voltage@1.preparation: Resting lysosomes in intact cultured HEK293 cells
matamala2021_lysosome_voltage@1.limits: The optical calibration uses an inferred zero-potential endpoint. The reported range for quantitative measurements is about −10 to +110 mV. The result is preparation-specific.

ojima2021_ampar_recycling@1.preparation: Resting primary hippocampal neuronal cultures, endogenous AMPA receptors
ojima2021_ampar_recycling@1.limits: The chase uses reference surface signal as its denominator. Remaining intracellular label at the end of the chase was unmeasured. The separate snapshot cannot supply that missing endpoint.

okamoto2016_retrieved_membrane@1.preparation: Stimulated calyx-of-Held terminals in brainstem slices at room temperature
okamoto2016_retrieved_membrane@1.limits: Seven terminals had simultaneous readings. Capacitance measures net surface membrane retrieval and the fluorescence also depends on vesicle re-acidification.

adarlevor2021_bridge_stalk@1.figure: 1D, with the membrane continuity comparison in 1E
adarlevor2021_bridge_stalk@1.observable: Microtubule-stalk diameter at the midbody rim in one representative bridge
adarlevor2021_bridge_stalk@1.extraction: Approximate centers read from the published single-bridge trace. Time is relative to the first plotted frame; use diameter ratios for normalized radius.
adarlevor2021_bridge_stalk@1.limits: The caption gives 18 bridges in five embryos. This representative series has no pointwise error bars. Membrane continuity can persist for minutes after tubulin disappears. The stalk is a proxy for aperture.

antanaviciute2018_bridge_conductance@1.preparation: Dividing sister cells from a human cell line connected by visible midbody-containing bridges
antanaviciute2018_bridge_conductance@1.observable: Electrical conductance between the two daughters
antanaviciute2018_bridge_conductance@1.limits: The authors do not identify the error statistic. Conductance is reported across bridges. The time in the illustrative recording is relative to the voltage ramp. Paired bridge radius over time and age since furrowing were unreported.

green2013_daughter_isolation@1.preparation: First division of C. elegans embryos, control condition
green2013_daughter_isolation@1.observable: Normalized inter-daughter exchange slope of 10 kDa dextran
green2013_daughter_isolation@1.limits: Graph readings are approximate. The slope denominator is the initial fluorescence difference between daughters. Each time bin has about ten slope estimates on average with partly overlapping windows. The last interval includes zero. The tracer is a macromolecule, and these data do not measure ionic conductance.
